proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + species_trait mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. No SpeciesTraitRecord exists. The taxonomy defines species_trait_root as a source atom but types.ts defines no mechanics family or record shape to hold it. Every species trait family currently lacks a payload schema.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Powerful Build is a species_trait; forcing it into ClassFeatureRecord would require fabricating className and acquiredAtLevel, which have no honest mapping.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: The grapple-escape mechanic grants Advantage specifically on ability checks (Athletics / Acrobatics). RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' — ability checks are absent. Even if a species_trait record existed, modify_roll_advantage on ability_check could not be encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_size_category (passive, for encumbrance rules)
proposed_widenings.justification: Counting as one size larger for carrying capacity is a non-combat passive property that modifies character-sheet calculations (Lifting/Carrying from SRD Equipment). It has no combat mechanic counterpart and likely sits outside core runtime scope per ARCHITECTURE.md. If the surface is to record it at all, a dedicated atom distinct from combat-facing modify_speed or grant_hover is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no SpeciesTraitRecord kind exists in UnitRecord, so no valid JSON shape is possible. Secondary: RollKind missing 'ability_check' would block the grapple-escape rider even if the family existed. Tertiary: carrying capacity is an encumbrance rule outside the combat core — it may warrant dm_agenda classification for that sub-mechanic specifically, but since the primary issue is structural we classify the whole unit as structural_widening.
